description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe sitting cross legged and barefoot on a bench on the pier near the edge of the lake; O'Keeffe looks directly at the camera with neutral expression with her hair on top of her head, she wears a long sleeve dress with smocking, arms are around legs which are pulled up to chest,  a pair of black laced shoes and sandals in foreground on wooden decking, ladder railing partially visible,  lake in background.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
